en: Just on top of what we're sharing, as a general manager, from kind of one month of observation and experience, I find several key points that I'd love to share with our team.
zh: 基于我担任总经理这一个月来的观察和体会，我想和团队分享几个关键点。

en: We have had a wonderful performance in this first part, especially in March and April, which I really appreciate. Generally, we performed very well.
zh: 这段时间我们的整体表现不错，尤其是三月和四月，我是认可的，总体来说做得很好。

en: However, we see that this performance is driven mainly from the rooms side, and then other revenues.
zh: 不过也能看出来，这波业绩主要还是由客房板块以及其他相关收入带动的。

en: We see that these revenues are still a little bit overfull from room occupancy, not from stand-alone business.
zh: 包括其他收入在内，目前更多还是依赖入住率拉动，还不是各板块真正独立做出来的。

en: So those are the areas I want to look into in detail, to improve and have a better balance. This is the first point.
zh: 所以这些地方我想再往下看细一点，把结构调得更均衡一些。这是第一点。

en: Also, according to the service index from the market, we can still see there are some gaps.
zh: 另外，从市场服务指数来看，我们仍然能看到一些差距。

en: We need to reach a certain level of service enhancement, and also product refining,
zh: 我们需要把服务再提升一个层级，同时继续打磨产品，

en: to improve our overall experience for the client. This is the area we need to look into in detail.
zh: 从而把客户感受到的整体体验做得更好。这也是接下来要重点细看的地方。

en: In several areas, I'm very happy to have very experienced leadership in our hotel, with many years of brand experience.
zh: 还有一点，我很高兴酒店拥有一支经验非常丰富的管理团队，也积累了多年的品牌经验。

en: But in certain areas of team and operation, I think our leadership engagement and leadership example are a little bit lacking.
zh: 但在团队管理和运营的某些环节，我觉得管理层的投入度，以及以身作则的示范，还稍显不足。

en: So I have to be front line, together with our leadership, to show how we can be a better brand leadership.
zh: 所以我会和管理层一起更多地下到一线，真正示范什么叫更好的品牌领导力。

en: Then our employees and juniors will also learn from this, feel motivated, and want to grow together.
zh: 这样员工，尤其年轻同事，也会从中学习，受到鼓舞，更愿意一起往前走。

en: Those are the areas I just wrote down, and I want to look at them over the next two to three months.
zh: 这些是我现在先记下来的重点，接下来两三个月我会持续跟进。

en: Lastly, just a small thing: through this first quarter, when looking into detail at our bottom line, we should also have a little bit of investment in our product planning, to see long-term growth.
zh: 最后补充一点，回看第一季度利润表现时，我们也要考虑做一些适度的前置投入，去支撑产品规划和长期增长。

en: Maybe temporarily, those numbers are great, but we really need to properly and wisely spend on certain areas to improve for next year, or for the second half, through continuous improvement.
zh: 也许短期看数字是漂亮的，但我们确实要更有节制、也更有策略地把钱投到关键领域，为明年和下半年的持续改进打基础。

en: So those are the areas where, in this first quarter, we didn't really do enough. I will look into them in detail with our whole team, to have a better balance in this part.
zh: 所以这些方面，在第一季度我们还没有真正做到位。接下来我会和整个团队把它逐项拆开来看，把这部分做得更均衡。

en: I have many more, but I'd love to guide our team in understanding each other, making it one vision and one goal, and then showing ownership later on.
zh: 我还有很多想法，但我更希望先带着团队彼此理解，形成同一个愿景、同一个目标，然后再把主人翁意识真正带出来。
